## Highlights

- **Agents on Pi keep working through long conversations.** Tale did not tell Pi how much context a model holds, so Pi took 128,000 tokens for every model it reached through Tale. Once a conversation came near that, Pi asked the model for a one-token answer and the run ended without a report ("the agent ended its turn without a final report"); a retry continued the same conversation and ended the same way. A long task stopped there, and so did a standing role whose runs continue one conversation. Pi now takes each model's context window from the model catalog, narrowed by the organization's [context limit](https://docs.tale.dev/platform/admin/governance/policies-and-limits), answers in full and compacts the conversation before it outgrows the window. A model whose window Tale cannot resolve keeps Pi's own sizing.

## Upgrade notes

- **Platform:** run the `0.5.105` images. No configuration change and no migration. An agent on Pi sizes its conversation to its model's window from its next run, so a task whose run ended this way can be started again and continues its conversation within that window.
